half_open_rule: Cooldown expires AND one explicitly tagged known-good probe succeeds before closing the provider circuit; company queue remains paused meanwhile.
empty_result_rule: Not a missing report, not zero. Stop scheduling this query route and check one known-good reference with corrected parameters. Resume only after semantic validation; no issuer-level manual requests.
failure_aggregation: One environment incident per provider route; affected companies remain NOT_ATTEMPTED_SOURCE_BLOCKED. Never create 1054 manual requests.

official_report_pdf: CNINFO adjunctUrl from validated issuer index
BSE official issuer disclosure for BJ; SSE/SZSE official issuer disclosure for SH/SZ (latter two not live-probed in this card)
financial_data: Explicit SH/SZ/BJ Sina paperCode; non-official structured data, official reconciliation deferred to P05/P07
Official report tables; extraction not implemented in P03
archived_original: Private connected Google Drive, lookup existing document_id/file_id first
Existing local cache; never delete unique originals

whole_universe_gate: P03 validates 3 known samples only. P04/P05/P06/P07 remain required. Any required route without a healthy known-good probe blocks the associated full collection.
scope: Small transport/routing adapter only; no pagination, no universe loop, no report-slot collection or business research.
